HANDOFF STATE 2026-11-10 PST (session 3d705fec)

Status: in_progress, unchanged. No boxes ticked, no description edits, no plan review run, no dispatch for this ticket.

What changed since the last handoff
- Blocker deceptive-banal-baboon's fix landed: Gerrit 3336 MERGED 2026-11-10 17:28 PST as 91182f96362 on origin/main (openai arm moved to gpt-5.5).
- Dispatch run https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/42939278248 on 91182f96362 (17:29 PST) is a dispatch, so it does NOT satisfy the last criterion; for context only: langfuse tracing round-trip success (compose up passed with the chainguard MinIO pin), openai success, anthropic success, but external LLM (live bedrock) FAILED, so that workflow run concluded failure.
- The bedrock failure is new: Bedrock Opus 5.5 (06b3b1a5230, 5.5 model upgrade) returns content_filtered in tests/external/test_structured_output_matrix.py. Filed as mustard-fungoid-grackle (relates_to this ticket). Unless it is fixed before the scheduled run, the scheduled run will also conclude failure and the last criterion stays unmet. Do not narrow the criterion to exclude bedrock.

What to check, and when
- The first SCHEDULED run after 3336: cron "0 6 * * 1" = Sunday 2026-11-15 22:00 PST; recent scheduled runs actually started 22:16-22:25 PST and took 16-18 min, so check after about 22:45 PST.
- Read-only, no dispatch: gh run list --workflow external-integration.yml --event schedule -L 1; then gh run view <id> --json conclusion,headSha,createdAt,jobs.
- Criterion needs: event=schedule, headSha containing 91182f96362; job "langfuse tracing round-trip (ephemeral self-hosted)" past `docker compose -f docker-compose.langfuse.yml up -d` with no MinIO pull error (grep the job log for minio / unauthorized / pull); and workflow conclusion success.
- If success: record run id, per-job conclusions and timestamp (PST) as a comment; tick all boxes, with indented provenance lines under the two [non-codebase] items (validate with rebar.llm.plan_review.det_measurement_provenance.provenance_gaps); re-run review-plan only if required; close --class preexisting from a worktree fast-forwarded to origin/main after make install. Never --force.
- If it fails only on bedrock (mustard-fungoid-grackle still open): record the run as evidence, leave this ticket in_progress, and wait for the next scheduled run after that bug's fix lands.
